newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end up on good corporate results.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end up on good corporate results.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended up on Wednesday on good corporate results, dealers said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index ended 6.82 points, or 0.39 percent, up at 1,769.43 amid 236 gainers and 118 losers. Volume rose to 71.7 million shares from Tuesday's 50.6 million.

The index rose on bullish sentiment in the high-priced Engro Chemical Pakistan Ltd that showed an after-tax profit of 77 percent for the year ended in December over 1995, one dealer said. Bullish sentiment in HUBCO on the eve of its first half result announcement also pulled the index up.

HUBCO rose 1.35 rupees to 42.75 in computerised trading in the evening. Engro jumped 9.00 to 175 after it announced 30 percent final cash dividend, in addition to 50 percent interim already paid and 25 percent bonus issues for the year ended in December compared to 20 percent bonus stocks for 1995.
Lever Bros gained 35 to 700, BOC 13 to 150 and Bawany Air 4.50 to 35. PSO fell 3.00 to 305 and PTCL 0.05 to 34.30.
